title: Tighten Audit Package Validator Errors and Run ID Scope

context.previous_merge: PR #1 Add minimal audit package validator and CLI
context.problem: The first validator implementation is useful, but two areas need tightening before the package validator becomes a clean governance primitive: summary.md read errors are not converted into deterministic validation results, and run_id consistency uses recursive scanning that can falsely reject future packages containing referenced/baseline run IDs.
design_principles: Prefer deterministic validation over raw exceptions
Validate canonical package fields, not every nested value in the universe
Do not expand into runtime ingestion, HTTP APIs, dashboard, auth, or reference-app coupling

task.summary: Make audit package validation error handling fully deterministic and narrow run_id consistency checks to canonical package fields.
task.user_story: As an Ailuros user, when I validate a v0.3 audit package, all package read/parse failures are returned as structured JSON reasons, and run_id mismatch detection only checks canonical package fields so referenced run IDs do not create false failures.
non_goals: Do not change the public decision values PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAIL.
Do not add HTTP API, dashboard, live runtime ingestion, runtime blocking, auth, or sessions.
Do not introduce Clarify, EverRun, radarCreation, browser, UI, or domain-specific concepts into src/ailuros.
Do not redesign the audit package format.
Do not weaken existing validation commands or remove existing tests.

required_behavior: Replace direct summary.md read_text usage in load_audit_package with a small deterministic text reader helper.
Convert summary.md UnicodeDecodeError, OSError, permission/read failures, and similar read failures into AuditPackageLoadError with stable reason text.
Ensure validate_audit_package_dir returns valid=false, decision=FAIL, and reasons for summary.md read failures instead of raw tracebacks.
Replace recursive run_id collection with canonical-location run_id collection.
Canonical run_id locations are: manifest.run_id, run.run_id, timeline[*].run_id when present, decisions[*].run_id when present, evaluations[*].run_id when present, regressions[*].run_id when present.

Do not inspect nested arbitrary run_id keys such as baseline_run_id, compared_run_id, referenced_run_id, metadata.run_id, or nested payload.run_id unless the repo already proves those are canonical package fields.
Preserve CLI JSON shape: valid, decision, reasons.
Keep normal CLI output machine-readable JSON.
suggested_changes: Add _read_text_file(path: Path) -> str next to _read_json_file and _read_jsonl_file.
Add helper(s) such as _top_level_run_id(record: Any) -> list[str] and _record_list_run_ids(value: Any) -> list[str].
Delete or stop using recursive _find_run_ids for package consistency checks.
Add tests that prove nested non-canonical run_id fields do not fail validation.
Add tests that prove unreadable or invalidly encoded summary.md produces structured FAIL. If chmod-based unreadable tests are platform-fragile, prefer invalid UTF-8 bytes for deterministic coverage.
expected_error_examples: malformed text in summary.md: invalid UTF-8

acceptance_criteria: A package with invalid UTF-8 bytes in summary.md returns valid=false and decision=FAIL with a reason naming summary.md.
A package with a summary.md read failure does not produce a raw traceback in normal CLI usage.
A package with manifest.run_id and run.run_id mismatch still fails deterministically.
A package with timeline[*].run_id mismatch still fails deterministically.
A package with decisions[*].run_id mismatch still fails deterministically.
A package containing nested metadata/baseline/reference run_id values that differ from the canonical run_id still passes if canonical fields are consistent.
Existing block decision behavior still returns valid=true, decision=FAIL, and the blocking reason.
Existing review decision behavior still returns valid=true, decision=REVIEW_REQUIRED, and the review reason.
CLI still emits JSON with valid, decision, and reasons fields for PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, and FAIL results.
No reference-app or domain-specific concepts are introduced into src/ailuros.

notes: If full pytest still fails due to known unrelated baseline Clarify/release smoke tests, report the exact failing tests and explain why they are unrelated to this pack.
Do not mark full validation green unless python -m pytest tests -q actually passes. Engineering is not theatre.

must_check: summary.md read/encoding failures are converted into structured PackageValidationResult FAIL output through validate_audit_package_dir.
Normal CLI failure output remains valid JSON and does not expose raw Python tracebacks for package read errors.
run_id consistency checking is limited to canonical top-level package fields and list records, not recursive arbitrary nested keys.
Canonical mismatches still fail: manifest/run, timeline record, decisions record, evaluations record, regressions record.
Nested non-canonical run_id-like values do not cause false FAIL results.
Existing PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, and FAIL decision precedence remains unchanged.
Tests are added for summary.md invalid UTF-8 or read error and nested non-canonical run_id false-positive prevention.
No forbidden paths or reference-application concepts are modified/introduced.
All validation commands are run and results are reported honestly.
reject_if: The fix catches broad exceptions and silently ignores broken package files.
The CLI emits non-JSON text for normal validation results.
The implementation continues to recursively scan every nested run_id key for consistency.
The implementation weakens canonical run_id mismatch detection.
The change introduces Clarify/EverRun/radarCreation/browser/UI/domain-specific coupling into src/ailuros.
The change expands scope into HTTP APIs, dashboard, live ingestion, runtime blocking, auth, sessions, or policy DSL.
Existing tests are deleted or loosened instead of adding targeted regression coverage.
Validation failures are hidden, skipped, or reported as success without evidence.

reasons: malformed text in summary.md: invalid UTF-8
